017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.saml;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.IoUtils.inflate;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
022
023import java.io.*;
024import java.nio.charset.*;

027import java.util.stream.*;

033/**
034 * {@link AuthFilter} that authenticates requests carrying a SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} delivered via
035 * the {@link SamlBinding#POST} or {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} HTTP binding.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * The {@link SamlBinding#POST} binding is accepted only on a {@code POST} request and {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} only
039 * on a {@code GET}.  A response to a request this SP sent must also present the binding cookie (see
040 * {@link Builder#bindingCookieName(String)}).
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * On each request this filter:
044 * <ol>
045 *    <li>Inspects the URL path against the configured {@code consumerPath} (default {@code /saml/acs}).  If the
046 *       request path does not match, returns {@link Optional#empty()} (filter does not apply).
047 *    <li>For the {@link SamlBinding#POST} binding: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} form parameter and
048 *       base64-decodes it.  For {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} query parameter,
049 *       base64-decodes it, and then DEFLATE-inflates (RFC 1951) per OASIS SAML 2.0 Redirect binding rules.
050 *    <li>Delegates to {@link SamlAssertionValidator#validate(String)}, which binds the assertion's bearer
051 *       {@code <SubjectConfirmation>} to the ACS URL configured on the validator.  On success,
052 *       builds an {@link AuthResult} carrying the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.  On failure, re-throws as
053 *       an {@link AuthenticationException} with a {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML ...} challenge.
054 * </ol>
055 *
056 * <h2 class='topic'>Roles</h2>
057 * <p>
058 * If the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal} contains a claim whose name equals the configured
059 * {@code rolesClaim} (default {@code "roles"}) and whose value is a {@link List} of {@link String}, those role
060 * names are populated on the {@link AuthResult}.  Otherwise the role set is empty.
061 *
062 * <h2 class='topic'>Usage</h2>
063 *
064 * <p>
065 * The validator carries the ACS URL; the request's own URL is never used to decide the expected recipient.
066 *
067 * <p class='bjava'>
068 *    <jk>var</jk> validator = SamlAssertionValidator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
069 *       .metadataResolver(SamlMetadataResolvers.<jsm>url</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/metadata"</js>))
070 *       .spEntityId(<js>"https://sp.example.com"</js>)
071 *       .expectedIssuer(<js>"https://idp.example.com"</js>)
072 *       .recipient(<js>"https://sp.example.com/saml/acs"</js>)
073 *       .build();
074 *
075 *    AuthFilterChain.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>bs</jv>)
076 *       .append(SamlAuthFilter.<jsm>create</jsm>()
077 *          .consumerPath(<js>"/saml/acs"</js>)
078 *          .binding(SamlBinding.<jsf>POST</jsf>)
079 *          .validator(<jv>validator</jv>)
080 *          .build())
081 *       .build();
082 * </p>
083 *
084 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2>
085 * <ul>
086 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlAssertionValidator}
087 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlBinding}
088 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://docs.oasis-open.org/security/saml/v2.0/saml-bindings-2.0-os.pdf">SAML 2.0 Bindings (OASIS)</a>
089 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/AuthFilterFramework">AuthN Filter Framework — Servlet-Layer Authentication</a>
090 * </ul>
091 *
092 * @since 10.0.0
093 */
094@SuppressWarnings({
095   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are SAML attribute names and HTTP header values; intentional
096})
097public class SamlAuthFilter extends AuthFilter {
098
099   private static final String DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH = "/saml/acs";
100   private static final String DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM = "roles";
101   private static final String DEFAULT_BINDING_COOKIE = "SAML_LOGIN";
102   private static final String SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM = "SAMLResponse";
103
104   /**
105    * Default ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
106    * {@code SAMLResponse} (1 MiB).
107    */
108   public static final long DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES = 1L * 1024 * 1024;
109
110   /**
111    * Default ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
112    * {@code SAMLResponse}.
113    */
114   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO = 100;
115
116   /**
117    * Static creator.
118    *
119    * @return A new builder.
120    */
121   public static Builder create() {
122      return new Builder();
123   }
124
125   /**
126    * Builder for {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
127    */
128   public static class Builder {
129      private SamlAssertionValidator validator;
130      private SamlBinding binding = SamlBinding.POST;
131      private String consumerPath = DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH;
132      private String rolesClaim = DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM;
133      private String realm = "saml";
134      private String bindingCookieName = DEFAULT_BINDING_COOKIE;
135      private long maxInflatedBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES;
136      private int maxInflateRatio = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO;
137
138      /** Constructor. */
139      protected Builder() {}
140
141      /**
142       * Sets the SAML assertion validator.
143       *
144       * @param value The validator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
145       * @return This object.
146       */
147      public Builder validator(SamlAssertionValidator value) {
148         validator = reqnn("value", value);
149         return this;
150      }
151
152      /**
153       * Sets the SAML binding the filter listens for.  Defaults to {@link SamlBinding#POST}.
154       *
155       * @param value The binding.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
156       * @return This object.
157       */
158      public Builder binding(SamlBinding value) {
159         binding = reqnn("value", value);
160         return this;
161      }
162
163      /**
164       * Sets the request path that carries the SAML assertion.  Defaults to {@code /saml/acs}.
165       *
166       * @param value The request path.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
167       * @return This object.
168       */
169      public Builder consumerPath(String value) {
170         consumerPath = reqnb("value", value);
171         return this;
172      }
173
174      /**
175       * Sets the claim name used to extract roles from the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.
176       *
177       * @param value The claim name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
178       * @return This object.
179       */
180      public Builder rolesClaim(String value) {
181         rolesClaim = reqnb("value", value);
182         return this;
183      }
184
185      /**
186       * Sets the {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML realm="<value>"} challenge realm.
187       *
188       * @param value The realm.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
189       * @return This object.
190       */
191      public Builder realm(String value) {
192         realm = reqnb("value", value);
193         return this;
194      }
195
196      /**
197       * Sets the name of the cookie that carries the browser-binding secret returned by
198       * {@link SamlAssertionValidator#rememberAuthnRequest(String)}.  Defaults to {@code SAML_LOGIN}.
199       *
200       * <p>
201       * The application sets this cookie (see {@link SamlAuthFilter#startLogin(HttpServletResponse, String)}) when it
202       * starts a login, and the filter passes its value to the validator along with the response.
203       *
204       * @param value The cookie name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
205       * @return This object.
206       */
207      public Builder bindingCookieName(String value) {
208         bindingCookieName = reqnb("value", value);
209         return this;
210      }
211
212      /**
213       * Sets the ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}
214       * {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES}.
215       *
216       * <p>
217       * A REDIRECT-binding {@code SAMLResponse} is DEFLATE-compressed in transit, so a small query-string
218       * payload can expand to a much larger document.  Decompression stops and the request is rejected once
219       * the running output exceeds this cap, so a highly-compressible payload cannot drive an unbounded
220       * allocation.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the absolute cap (the ratio guard still applies).
221       *
222       * @param value The maximum decompressed size in bytes.
223       * @return This object.
224       */
225      public Builder maxInflatedBytes(long value) {
226         maxInflatedBytes = value;
227         return this;
228      }
229
230      /**
231       * Sets the ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a
232       * {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to
233       * {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO}.
234       *
235       * <p>
236       * This guard catches a highly-compressible payload even when the absolute
237       * {@link #maxInflatedBytes(long) byte cap} is generous.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the ratio guard.
238       *
239       * @param value The maximum output-to-input ratio.
240       * @return This object.
241       */
242      public Builder maxInflateRatio(int value) {
243         maxInflateRatio = value;
244         return this;
245      }
246
247      /**
248       * Builds the filter.
249       *
250       * @return A new {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
251       */
252      public SamlAuthFilter build() {
253         if (validator == null)
254            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAuthFilter requires a SamlAssertionValidator");
255         return new SamlAuthFilter(this);
256      }
257   }
258
259   private final SamlAssertionValidator validator;
260   private final SamlBinding binding;
261   private final String consumerPath;
262   private final String rolesClaim;
263   private final String challenge;
264   private final String bindingCookieName;
265   private final long maxInflatedBytes;
266   private final int maxInflateRatio;
267
268   /**
269    * Constructor.
270    *
271    * @param b The builder to read configuration from.
272    */
273   protected SamlAuthFilter(Builder b) {
274      this.validator = b.validator;
275      this.binding = b.binding;
276      this.consumerPath = b.consumerPath;
277      this.rolesClaim = b.rolesClaim;
278      this.bindingCookieName = b.bindingCookieName;
279      this.challenge = "SAML realm=\"" + b.realm + "\"";
280      this.maxInflatedBytes = b.maxInflatedBytes;
281      this.maxInflateRatio = b.maxInflateRatio;
282   }
283
284   @Override /* Overridden from AuthFilter */
285   public Optional<AuthResult> authenticate(HttpServletRequest req) throws AuthenticationException {
286      if (!matchesPath(req) || !matchesMethod(req))
287         return oe();
288      var raw = req.getParameter(SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM);
289      if (isEmpty(raw))
290         return oe();
291      var xml = decodeSamlResponse(raw);
292      var principal = runValidator(xml, bindingCookie(req));
293      return o(AuthResult.of(principal, extractRoles(principal)));
294   }
295
296   /**
297    * Registers an outgoing authentication request and sends the browser-binding cookie that this filter checks on
298    * the response.
299    *
300    * <p>
301    * Call this when redirecting the browser to the identity provider, passing the {@code ID} attribute of the
302    * {@code <AuthnRequest>} being sent.  The method calls {@link SamlAssertionValidator#rememberAuthnRequest(String)}
303    * and adds a cookie named by {@link Builder#bindingCookieName(String)} carrying the returned secret.
304    *
305    * <p>
306    * Cookie attributes:
307    * <ul>
308    *    <li>{@code Secure} and {@code HttpOnly}: the value is never needed by page scripts and is sent only over HTTPS.
309    *    <li>{@code SameSite=None}: the POST binding delivers the response as a cross-site form post from the identity
310    *       provider, and browsers omit {@code Lax} and {@code Strict} cookies on that request.  {@code None} requires
311    *       {@code Secure}.
312    *    <li>{@code Path=/}: the ACS URL as seen by the browser includes the context and servlet paths, which this filter
313    *       does not know, so the cookie is scoped to the whole site.
314    *    <li>{@code Max-Age}: the validator's request lifetime, see {@link SamlAssertionValidator.Builder#authnRequestTtl(java.time.Duration)}.
315    * </ul>
316    *
317    * <p class='bjava'>
318    *    <jv>filter</jv>.startLogin(<jv>res</jv>, <jv>authnRequestId</jv>);
319    *    <jv>res</jv>.sendRedirect(<jv>idpUrlCarryingTheRequest</jv>);
320    * </p>
321    *
322    * @param res The response being sent to the browser.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
323    * @param requestId The {@code ID} attribute of the outgoing {@code <AuthnRequest>}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
324    * @throws IllegalStateException If the validator's store cannot accept more outstanding requests.
325    */
326   public void startLogin(HttpServletResponse res, String requestId) {
327      var secret = validator.rememberAuthnRequest(requestId);
328      var c = new Cookie(bindingCookieName, secret);
329      c.setSecure(true);
330      c.setHttpOnly(true);
331      c.setPath("/");
332      c.setMaxAge((int)Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE, validator.getAuthnRequestTtl().toSeconds()));
333      c.setAttribute("SameSite", "None");
334      res.addCookie(c);
335   }
336
337   // The POST binding is delivered by a form post and the REDIRECT binding by a GET; other methods are not accepted.
338   private boolean matchesMethod(HttpServletRequest req) {
339      return eq(binding == SamlBinding.POST ? "POST" : "GET", req.getMethod());
340   }
341
342   private String bindingCookie(HttpServletRequest req) {
343      var cookies = req.getCookies();
344      if (cookies != null)
345         for (var c : cookies)
346            if (eq(bindingCookieName, c.getName()))
347               return c.getValue();
348      return null;
349   }
350
351   private boolean matchesPath(HttpServletRequest req) {
352      var p = req.getPathInfo();
353      var s = p != null ? p : req.getServletPath();
354      return s != null && eq(s, consumerPath);
355   }
356
357   private String decodeSamlResponse(String raw) throws AuthenticationException {
358      try {
359         byte[] decoded = Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(raw);
360         return switch (binding) {
361            // Per SAML 2.0 Redirect binding: raw DEFLATE (no zlib wrapper), decompressed under a hard
362            // output-size cap and ratio guard so a compressible payload cannot force an unbounded allocation.
363            case REDIRECT -> new String(inflate(decoded, true, maxInflatedBytes, maxInflateRatio), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
364            // Per SAML 2.0 POST binding: the base64-decoded bytes are the raw XML document.
365            case POST -> new String(decoded, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
366         };
367      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
368         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter is not valid base64")
369            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
370      } catch (IOException e) {
371         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter could not be inflated (REDIRECT binding)")
372            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
373      }
374   }
375
376   private Principal runValidator(String xml, String browserBinding) throws AuthenticationException {
377      try {
378         var p = validator.validate(xml, browserBinding);
379         if (p == null)
380            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML validator returned null").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
381         return p;
382      } catch (AuthenticationException e) {
383         var hasChallenge = e.getHeaders().stream()
384            .anyMatch(h -> eqic("WWW-Authenticate", h.getName()));
385         if (!hasChallenge)
386            e.wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
387         throw e;
388      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
389         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML validation failed").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
390      }
391   }
392
393   @SuppressWarnings({
394      "unchecked" // Type erasure on reflective/generic cast; element type is verified at call site
395   })
396   private Set<String> extractRoles(Principal principal) {
397      if (principal instanceof ClaimsPrincipal principal2) {
398         var v = principal2.getClaims().get(rolesClaim);
399         if (v instanceof List<?> v2) {
400            return ((List<Object>) v2).stream()
401               .filter(String.class::isInstance)
402               .map(String.class::cast)
403               .collect(Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new));
404         }
405      }
406      return Collections.emptySet();
407   }
408}
